SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, TARGET AS PLANT, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, KEY_3 AS LEGACY_GR_NO, KEY_4 AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND KEY_7 IN (' ','T')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KOL3' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(TARGET,' ') AS PLANT, ISNULL(KEY_1,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, ISNULL(KEY_2,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, ISNULL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ISNULL(CURRENCY_CODE,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(UNIT_PRICE, 0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(GR_QTY, 0) AS GR_QTY, ISNULL(GR_AMT, 0) AS GR_AMT, ISNULL(GR_DATE,' ') AS GR_DATE, ISNULL(LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO1, ISNULL(LEGACY_PR_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_SEQ1, ISNULL(LEGACY_PR_NO,' ')+'-'+ISNULL(LEGACY_PR_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, ISNULL(KEY_3,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO, ISNULL(KEY_4,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, ISNULL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, ISNULL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM V_KEP_GR LEFT JOIN KEPTRXL ON KEPTRXL.TARGET = V_KEP_GR.PLANT AND KEPTRXL.KEY_1 = V_KEP_GR.LEGACY_PO_NO AND KEPTRXL.KEY_2 = V_KEP_GR.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND KEPTRXL.KEY_3 = V_KEP_GR.LEGACY_GR_NO AND KEPTRXL.KEY_4 = V_KEP_GR.LEGACY_GR_SEQ AND KEPTRXL.DOC_NAME= '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEPTRXL.KEY_7 IN (' ','T') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_7 IN (' ','T') AND TARGET = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' ORDER BY TARGET,KEY_3,KEY_4, KEY_1, KEY_2
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET KEY_7 = 'Y', KEY_6 = GETDATE() WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_7 IN (' ','T') AND TARGET = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$'
